reason: Nathaniel Young (E031) requested write access to Payroll. HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, and Facilities notes consistently confirm E031 is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Per policy, full-time employees may have up to write (admin only if the role owns the system, which is the case here, but write was requested). The requested write is at or below the maximum, so grant write. The single contradicting Security note claiming contractor status with basic training is outweighed by the corroborating records from HR and other agents, and even under that view the maximum would only be reduced—but the preponderance of evidence supports full-time employment. No more than the requested level is granted.
